title: 상자도표 box plot

date: 2026-04-21

---

#### 패키지 Graphics

```{r}
#| collapse: true
#| code-overflow: wrap
#| prompt: true
#| comment: "#>"
str(InsectSprays)
boxplot(count ~ spray, data = InsectSprays)
```

#### 패키지 ggplot2

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data = InsectSprays, aes(x = spray, y = count)) + 
  geom_boxplot()
```
